en.headline: Man airlifted after feeling unwell and falling on Tung Chung hike
en.dek: A 40-year-old man in a group of six was hoisted by Government Flying Service helicopter from near Pak To Shan after feeling unwell and slipping, then taken to Ruttonjee Hospital.
body: A Government Flying Service helicopter airlifted a man from a trail near Pak To Shan in Tung Chung on Sunday afternoon after he felt unwell and fell, according to reports.

At about 2.05pm, a group of five men and one woman set out from near Tung Chung Caribbean Coast towards Mui Wo. Near Pak To Shan, one of the men, aged about 40, felt unwell and slipped, injuring himself. The helicopter winched him to the Wan Chai helipad, where an ambulance transferred him to Ruttonjee Hospital for treatment.
No further details on his condition were immediately available.

zh.headline: 東涌外籍男子行山不適跌傷 直升機吊起送院
zh.dek: 下午約2時，東涌壁刀屹附近一名約40歲男子懷疑中暑不適並跌倒受傷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將事主吊起送律敦治醫院治療。
body: 星期日下午約2時05分，5男1女行山客由東涌影灣園附近出發往梅窩，途經壁刀屹時，其中一名約40歲男子懷疑中暑缺水不適，再跌倒受傷。
政府飛行服務隊直升機到場，將事主吊起送往灣仔停機坪，再由救護車送律敦治醫院治療。
暫未有進一步傷勢資料。
